scope: Read-only review of25selected P0 first frames and the full selected Sonic atlas; three of these P0 frames were enlarged again against newly obtained authentic sources. This is not a visual certification of the entire1912-character roster.

limitations: La barge et le portrait impérial sont deux moments distincts du même film1983 ; ne pas ajouter le gant noir au début de la barge sur la seule base de la continuité ultérieure.
Bas du pantalon/bottes, dos, hilt complet et gant droit mécanique ne sont pas qualifiés visuellement par ces cadrages.
Les deux images fournissent une vraie cible visuelle sourcée et ne valident aucune image générée ou aucun atlas1:1.
Ce sont des images du rôle et du film explicitement créditées Warner Bros. France, pas des portraits de l’acteur hors personnage.
Ces trois cadrages ne constituent pas un turntable ni une vue lisible de la baguette.
Aucune majorité n’est inventée : incarnation adolescente, usages familiaux et non romantiques.
Aucune comparaison à ces sources ne certifie automatiquement1:1 les sprites du projet.
AlloCiné héberge ces images de publicité créditées Warner Bros. France ; le crédit du distributeur est attesté, aucune licence générale de réutilisation n’est affirmée.
Une couverture officielle en composition de combat ne constitue pas un turntable du modèle.
La construction verte appartient à la scène JusticeLeague et ne fait pas partie du costume ; ne pas l’importer dans la silhouette de Batman.
Abdomen, ceinture, dos et détails des bottes/accessoires non qualifiés par ce cadrage.
Les couvertures36/37et40 ont été réellement vues puis exclues explicitement ; leur publication dans le même arc ne les rend pas sources du costume de base.
Ce reçu qualifie une vraie cible de source et ne certifie aucun sprite ou image générée1:1.

findings.observed: Selected first frame is a blond fantasy adventurer with brown cape, cream tunic, blue/gold trim and a bright blue blade, rather than the inspected ROTJ1983 dark tunic and green-blade identity.

sourceComparison.observedDetails: Luke visible à mi-corps sur la barge de Jabba, cheveux bruns, tunique/épaules noires, sabre à lame verte. Vue publiée dans la section consacrée au Retour du Jedi.

findings.proposedLockAmendment: Use the chosen ROTJ1983 incarnation: brown film hair, closed black upper clothing and green blade. Inspect a complete source for trousers/boots, hilt and the later right glove before asserting their exact geometry. Do not import the beige fantasy-knight costume or blue blade.
findings.proposedAction: One legitimate source-referenced correction request was refused at output by the generation service. No output exists to inspect or install; preserve historical sprite and unresolved differences without claiming delivery.

findings.observed: Selected first frame has an ornate long navy/gold coat, decorated waistcoat, brown high boots and a large compass-like artifact. The inspected OotP film stills show ordinary dark/gray clothes and fine round spectacles; no such ornate coat or large compass is present.

sourceComparison.observedDetails: Harry dans la salle des prophéties : lunettes rondes fines, cheveux bruns courts irréguliers, visage adolescent, tee-shirt bleu à col foncé et veste de sport sombre à fines bandes.

findings.proposedLockAmendment: Retain the adolescent OotP2007 role face, short untidy brown hair and thin round spectacles. Choose one documented film outfit consistently; remove the invented gold-trimmed fantasy coat and compass. Wand geometry remains to qualify from a readable image, not infer from these torso stills.
findings.proposedAction: Produce a source-referenced correction under the chosen film incarnation, preserve the old PNG as a historical variant, and inspect all16frames plus packing before switching runtime. No new generation attempted in this audit.
findings.sourceCoverageDecision: Not attempted: shoe/ankle/full-leg silhouette and readable wand missing from three inspected stills.

findings.observed: Selected first frame is an uncovered brown-haired human with hair tied back, broad rectangular goggles, gray technical parka, orange harness/cable tool and no bat cowl or cape. The official Endgame#35 source instead establishes black pointed cowl, white drawn eyes, exposed jaw, black cape/gauntlets and gray torso.

sourceComparison.observedDetails: Couverture standard New52 Batman#35, EndgamePart1. Batman au centre porte une cagoule noire à deux pointes, yeux blancs dessinés, mâchoire découverte, cape noire ample, tunique grise à emblème chauve-souris noir, gants/gauntlets noirs. Corps humain standard ; aucun casque Nolan ni JusticeBuster. La construction verte de GreenLantern masque l’abdomen/ceinture et une partie des jambes.

findings.proposedLockAmendment: Restore standard New52 Endgame identity from the inspected issue#35: pointed black cowl, covered hair, white comic eyes, exposed human jaw, black cape/gauntlets and gray bat-emblem torso. Do not import Nolan segmentation, generic goggles/parka, giant green fist from the surrounding scene, JusticeBuster or symbolic winged#40costume. Exact belt/back/boots remain unqualified by this cover.
findings.proposedAction: A future source-referenced sprite correction must preserve the old PNG as a historical variant and receive full16frame/packing review. No generation attempted in this audit.
findings.sourceCoverageDecision: Not attempted: authentic issue#35cover establishes head/torso/cape but GreenLantern construction hides abdomen/belt and much of lower body; complete costume/equipment reference still needed.

resolvedDocumentaryFindings.observed: The selected atlas is already blue Modern Sonic with long legs and green irises. The old workbook lock proposed Classic1991 and runtime primary/secondary colors are yellow; those numeric gameplay fields do not define the blue character.
resolvedDocumentaryFindings.correction: Owned authored lock now targets the inspected SEGA Modern profile; runtime palette and all artwork files are unchanged.
